title: Two-Valued Groups, Chazy Equation, Dubrovin-Frobenius Structures, and QYBE
summary: We show that the associativity condition of the universal symmetric 2-algebraic 2-valued group defined by the Buchstaber polynomial admits several mutually equivalent interpretations from the viewpoints of the Chazy equation, Gauss-Manin connections, Dubrovin-Frobenius structures, and the quantum Yang-Baxter equation. These results place the universal 2-valued law in a unified framework linking geometry, algebraic topology, group theory, and mathematical physics.
